reviewed_inline_sample_cases.source: ISO32000-1 §8.9.7 p216 expressly treats ID..EI bytes as stream data (§7.3.8); §7.3.8.2 p20 requires sample dimensions and decoded extent to agree.
reviewed_inline_sample_cases.independent_decoder: Python standard-library zlib used only during development; no engine/code imported into the app
reviewed_inline_sample_cases.interpretation: Flate is the only declared filter. Its decoded JPEG bytes are raw RGB samples under this dictionary, not an implicit DCT stream. 1062 bytes exceed the 3-byte pixel specified. Historical per-clause pass label does not override this independent model violation.
